# Tejas Rajagopal

> Brand-led generalist designer for fintech, AI and crypto. A few favourites from the archive.

Every startup starts as a story. I help founders tell it through brand, product and marketing, so the idea feels real from day one. These are some of my work.

- Site: https://tejasrajagopal.com/
- Focus: brand, product and marketing design for fintech, AI and crypto startups
- Experience: 5+ years working at mpay, MARA, Flipkart, DEZERV and Cur

## Selected work

- [Nyuway](https://tejasrajagopal.com/works/nyuway-1.webp): Enterprise AI Security & Compliance — Brand & Web Design · 2025. Nyuway empowers enterprises to stay secure by preventing data leaks, shadow AI, and compliance risks across modern AI tools. Its brand identity blends the dynamic energy of matrix-style technographics with the clarity of glass — a visual language of transparency and strength.
- [River](https://tejasrajagopal.com/works/river-1.webp): See what's working with AI — Product & Brand Design · 2025. River is an AI-powered tool that gives you a clear, actionable audit of your Meta Ads campaigns. It uses advanced analysis to pinpoint what's working, what's wasting budget, and what to do next — all explained in plain English, not marketing jargon. We did their branding and product design.
- [South of Summer](https://tejasrajagopal.com/works/south-of-summer-1.webp): Brand & Web Design
- [Avant](https://tejasrajagopal.com/works/avant-1.webp): Real World Tokenisation Platform — Brand & Product Design · 2024. Avant is a wealth management platform for crypto treasury teams to collateralize bitcoin and earn real-world yield. Users borrow stablecoins against their bitcoin collateral and trade ownership stakes of whiskey, real estate, and clean energy. We were responsible for the branding as well as the product design.
- [EvolveYou](https://tejasrajagopal.com/works/evolveyou-1.webp): Fitness for Women — Socials & In-App Content · 2025. The strength training and wellbeing app made by women, for women. We edited social media and in-app content for EvolveYou, with over 80 videos including running campaigns and new program launches.
